claims: As of April 10, 2026, the March 2026 CPI report shows US inflation at 3.3% year-over-year.
The March 2026 CPI report shows US inflation up from 2.4% in February.
The March 2026 CPI report shows monthly prices rising 0.9%.
The March 2026 CPI report shows core CPI rose 2.6% annually.
The March 2026 CPI core month-over-month change is +0.2%.
The March 2026 CPI energy index increased 12.5% over the last 12 months.
The Bureau of Labor Statistics releases CPI around 8:30 a.m. ET between the 10th and 13th of each month.
CPI data covers All Urban Consumers (CPI-U).
CPI data covers Urban Wage Earners and Clerical Workers (CPI-W).
Core CPI excludes volatile food and energy prices.
Headline CPI includes volatile food and energy prices.
